title: feat: persist and display route points on the saved route page
description: During route creation MapClient renders a 'Route points' list (Start / Waypoint N / Finish with lat, lon) from the clicked waypoints. On save only the LineString geometry is persisted; individual waypoints are never stored, so the saved route page has no data to render that list. Persist the user waypoints in a new nullable JSONB column on routes and surface them on /routes/[id] reusing the existing .waypoints CSS/markup.
requirements: Add a nullable jsonb 'waypoints' column to public.routes with a GIN index (migration after 20261001180000_routes_author.sql).
Keep lib/db/schema.ts in sync with the migration so npm run db:generate shows no drift.
Validate optional waypoints in lib/route-validation.ts (each [lon,lat] finite and within bounds, cap MAX_WAYPOINTS=500), defaulting to undefined when absent.
Persist waypoints on create; updateRoute must conditionally set waypoints only when provided (edit-safe).
getRouteForViewer and getPublicRoute select and return waypoints as an array or null.
MapClient.saveRoute sends waypoints in the POST body.
app/routes/[id]/page.tsx renders a 'Route points' card reusing existing CSS, mirroring MapClient markup; legacy routes show 'No points yet'.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run db:generate reports no schema drift vs the new migration.
Existing route/validation tests still pass (npm run test:run).
A created route with 2+ clicks shows a 'Route points' list matching the creation view on the saved page.
A legacy route saved before this change shows 'No points yet'.
Editing title/description/geometry via PATCH preserves existing waypoints.
technicalApproach: Store ordered array of [lon, lat] in a nullable jsonb column to match geometry coordinate order everywhere.
Render on the viewer as lat, lon (point[1], point[0]) to mirror MapClient exactly.
Conditional SET in updateRoute so omitting waypoints preserves existing values.
definitionOfReady: GitHub Issue exists with goal and acceptance criteria.
Dedicated branch task/c9d2-persist-route-points created from main.
definitionOfDone: db:generate shows no drift, tsc passes, tests pass.
Task history and commit metadata are updated.
Implementation PR references TASK-c9d2 / Closes the issue.

decisionLog.decision: Use a nullable jsonb column for waypoints instead of a separate table.
decisionLog.reason: MVP simplicity and smallest change; matches 'smallest change' guidance and needs no new endpoint.
